title: Add copilot-setup-steps.yml to pre-warm dev environment
body:
- [x] Remove `CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0` from `copilot-setup-steps.yml` so incremental builds are enabled for the agent
- [x] Add `--locked` to `cargo build --workspace` to match CI conventions and prevent silent lockfile updates
- [x] Remove `push` trigger — `pull_request` + `workflow_dispatch` is sufficient for validating this file
